source.dm_frac: [AS] solution; the solids content is not tracked.
source.density_kg_m3: [D] LfL Bayern, Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstoffflusse Bas22 (12/2021) Tab. 3: AHL 28 holds 28 kg N per 100 kg and 36 kg N per 100 l.
source.n_total_kg_t: [C] LfL Bayern, Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstoffflusse Bas22 (12/2021) Tab. 3 / 5a: AHL 28, 28 kg N per 100 kg.
source.nh4_n_kg_t: [C] LfL Bayern, Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstoffflusse Bas22 (12/2021) Tab. 3 / 5a: 7 kg NH4-N per 100 kg.
source.urea_n_kg_t: [D] AHL is half urea N; (28 - 7 - 7) = 14 kg per 100 kg.
source.no3_n_kg_t: [D] AHL is a quarter nitrate N: 7 kg per 100 kg.
source.p2o5_kg_t: [C] LfL Bayern, Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstoffflusse Bas22 (12/2021) Tab. 3 / 5a
source.k2o_kg_t: [C] LfL Bayern, Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstoffflusse Bas22 (12/2021) Tab. 3 / 5a
source.cao_kg_t: [C] LfL Bayern, Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstoffflusse Bas22 (12/2021) Tab. 3: AHL 28 acidifies by 28 kg CaO per 100 kg.

source.k_vol_per_day: [D] EMEP/EEA Guidebook 2023, 3.D Table 3-2 / A1.1 (g NH3 per kg N applied, soil pH <= 7): UAN 87 g NH3 per kg N = 7.2 % of the N, 9.6 % of its ammoniacal and urea three quarters; share 0.096 at a total rate of 4.6 per day.
source.k_inf_per_mm_rain: [AS] extra infiltration rate per mm of rain that day (the Guidebook only says that rain has a significant effect on the fertiliser emission factor).
